MithraX is Private AI Memory.

Listen → Transcribe → Understand → Remember → Search → Answer

There is no account, no backend, and no cloud AI API in this app. Audio, transcripts, memories, search, and answers stay on this phone.

Meetings records only after you tap Record. Transcription uses a bundled on-device Vosk model; if that model is not packaged in the install, recording still works but speech-to-text will fail locally rather than sending audio anywhere.

Transcripts are understood on this phone and Ask answers from stored conversations and memories. Memories are also extracted on-device when a transcript exists. Settings shows storage and lets you delete it.
